queries.description: SELECT country, COUNT(*), SUM(bytes) FROM events WHERE event_id <= 100000 GROUP BY country ORDER BY country
SELECT event_id, country, score FROM events WHERE event_id BETWEEN 200000 AND 201000 ORDER BY score DESC, event_id ASC LIMIT 25
SELECT u.segment, COUNT(*) FROM events e JOIN users u ON e.user_id = u.user_id WHERE e.event_id <= 100000 GROUP BY u.segment ORDER BY u.segment
SELECT event_id, duration_ms FROM events WHERE event_id <= 100000 AND score >= 99.5 ORDER BY event_id ASC LIMIT 50
